turns.text: Air pollution has become a serious problem in Lahore, especially in winter when the smog gets really thick.
A lot of it comes from vehicles and from farmers burning crop residue in the surrounding areas.
The government has tried a few measures, like closing schools on the worst days, but these are only temporary solutions.
What we really need is better public transport and stricter rules for factories, which would cut emissions over time.
Individuals can contribute as well, for instance by car-sharing, although I admit that's not very common here yet.
